issues: Google review performance was strong for the week and the site achieved its sales target.
Maintenance requests were submitted for a broken grease trap and a faulty window and dispenser unit that needs replacing.
The glass washer has an occasional leak and the maintenance engineer is aware and attending to inspect it.
Around forty additional hours were requested to support a heavy preparation workload.
A front of house team member is being trained to provide kitchen cover over the holiday period.
A back of house team member transferred in from Ikigai the previous week.
Two front of house team members have returned, a third returns at the end of September 2026, and another has given notice to leave in October 2026.
Heavy app voucher redemption is pulling spend per head down, as most customers have now unlocked the free ramen and half price bill offers.
XOXO, the Matcha promotion and student night are live, but the site has no marketing materials for the student night running the following day.
All site compliance areas were completed and swept.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Following a Char Siu quality problem traced to the supplier, all sites must stay vigilant when opening new Char Siu deliveries, carry out random quality checks and test product quality before serving.

Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): Frozen ramen, ramen bowls and inner containers are to be ordered exclusively from JFC, while takeaway packaging remains with Lynas because of JFC packaging quality inconsistencies.
Region-wide (Scotland & Newcastle): The weekly BOH KPI meeting reverts to its regular Tuesday 10:30 slot, with the next one on 22/09/2026.

EDI/NEW 15/09: The app caused severe revenue loss because staff had been redeeming multiple vouchers on a single table, in one case a table of seven settling at £23. Updated terms and conditions are now enforced to stop the practice.
EDI/NEW 15/09: Sides underperformed because the app is steering customers towards ramen.
EDI/NEW 15/09: The ventilation certificates have been misplaced.
EDI/NEW 15/09: A right to work check is being processed for a new starter.
EDI/NEW 15/09: The leaking glass wash was reported but the engineer checked the ice machine instead, so it remains outstanding.
EDI/NEW 15/09: The XOXO promotion is running with the mango puri and blood orange deliveries arriving a day late.
EDI/NEW 15/09: The student night is expected to be very busy and the site still needs pricing confirmation and marketing materials.
